headline: Widening Storm: Callums Cape and Mooring County Bear the Brunt
war_summary: The storm has widened since the last edition, not cooled. Callums Cape again leads the ledger: nearly 4,700 two-hour losses between the armies, hourly counts accelerating, and flags turning to within a quarter hour of this filing—46 events at the flags in the day about Naofa, Scouts Jest and Ire leave its posts split three and three, one a ruin. Mooring County runs nearly level, some 5,000 two-hour casualties with the hourly count climbing about The Wind Hills; ten posts there fly Warden colours against two. Weathered Expanse's exchange quickened sharply around Crow's Nest, where six bases stand Warden, one Colonial, two ruined, and Linn Mercy likewise sped up at Outwich Ranch and Rotdust, its flags standing seven Colonial to three Warden. Marban Hollow's two-hour toll eased, yet Checkpoint Bua logged movement to the filing hour. A fresh flare shows in Lykos Isle, five events in two hours about The Squall and Fort Guile, with Stlican Shelf stirring at Briar. Stonecradle has been still since mid-afternoon, the Nevish Line since early morning, Godcrofts since forenoon; Callahans Passage records only a Warden capture at Crumbling Post the previous evening. It is the 796th day; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
